questions: This 2015 piano ballad became a global smash as the lead single from an album titled simply '25,' with lyrics steeped in nostalgia and regret. What is it?
Hello (Adele song) is a song recorded by British singer-songwriter Adele, released on 23 October 2015 by XL Recordings as the lead single from her third studio album, 25 (2015).
Nicknamed 'The Leader' in Arabic, this Doha-based sports club is the only Qatari side to have won the AFC Champions League, with a national-record 64 football titles — what club is it?
Al Sadd SC: Sports club in Qatar. It is best known for its association football team, which competes in the top level of Qatari football, the Qatar Stars League.

This Eighteenth-Dynasty Egyptian ruler was only the second woman confirmed to reign in her own right, and had herself depicted as a man to reinforce her authority — who was she?
